title: From Bihar to Rajasthan: How a Rs 130 Crore Sand Mining Scam Spread Across States
description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has launched a multi-state crackdown in Bihar, Delhi, and Rajasthan in an alleged Rs 130 crore illegal sand mining and money laundering case. At the center is Mahadev Enclave Pvt Ltd, linked to the Chandak family, with IIT Patna’s geospatial study triggering the probe.
